organiser.name: The Channon Craft Market Inc. (non-profit, volunteer management committee)

add_sources.note: @the.channon.craft.market profile links to thechannonmarket.org.au; home page titled 'The Channon Craft Market Inc | 2nd Sunday of the Month' and showed '11th of October 2026'.

History page: The Channon Craft Market Inc. formed in 1976; now a 'Non-Profit Community Organisation with a Management Committee of nine volunteers' employing about 18 staff; over 240 stallholders; held at Coronation Park.
Stallholder page lists admin@thechannonmarket.org.au; contact page routes general inquiries to the Market Manager and gives 02 6688 6433. No sponsorship contact.
'The Channon Craft Market will celebrate an extraordinary milestone this Sunday, 11 October, marking 50 years' (Google snippet); a Facebook post by a local MP the next day describes the day as held.
Site describes it as a 'Pet and Alcohol Free Event'.

add_gaps: No sponsors found; 50th anniversary Bioblitz partners (Jagun Alliance, OzFish Unlimited, Rous County Council) partnered the Bioblitz activity, not the market
Visitor numbers not published; site gives over 240 stallholders
Market is pet and alcohol free, which limits some brand formats
remove_gaps: Dates inferred from the second-Sunday pattern
notes: Official site and organiser (The Channon Craft Market Inc., non-profit with a volunteer committee and about 18 staff) confirmed; 50th anniversary market held 11 Oct 2026. Maker-only market with no brand sponsors; alcohol and pet free.
